label: Required stance
help: Any, normal stance only, or rolling stance only.

label: Stance transition
help: Enter rolling stance on successful hit, or exit when the action starts.

label: Action behavior
help: 0 strike; 1 held guard; 2 stance exit; 3 stall/dive; 4 grab sequence; 5 hold to charge; 6 air projectile stall/recoil; 7 grappler capture; 8 anti-air super (50% Momentum); 9 armored rush; 10 rush brake; 11 hold-D shield advance (upper armor); 12 multi-hit shield descent.

label: Held-input destination
help: Move slot entered by holding the button. Charge actions use its active frames at full charge; -1 has no follow-up.

label: Hold transition frame
help: Absolute attack frame at which holding enters the follow-up. For charge attacks, this is the full-charge startup.

label: Guard hold button
help: Button to keep held when previewing this guard action.

label: Guard attack destination
help: Opposite S/Hs input starts this move from held guard; -1 disables.

label: Close-distance move
help: Alternate move selected when starting this input within the proximity range.

label: Close-distance range
help: Root-to-root distance for the close version; checked at move start.

label: Startup travel
help: Forward movement per startup tick; retains authored run/dash carry.

label: Dive / recoil horizontal speed
help: Local forward velocity for dive or air projectile recoil. Negative recoil moves away from the opponent.

label: Dive / recoil vertical speed
help: Downward speed during the active dive. Startup holds air velocity.

label: Air-hit ground bounce
help: One bounce upward at ground contact, only when this move hits an airborne target.

label: Air-hit wall bounce
help: One rebound away from the wall; velocity still damages wall health and depleted walls splat first.

label: Grounded floating crumple
help: Grounded hit enters a vulnerable floating crumple for this many ticks.

label: Air counter-hit knockdown
help: Override knockdown on an airborne counter hit; 0 keeps the ordinary result.

label: Hurtbox window begins
help: Move-frame start of a finer body-region mask; 0 disables the window.

label: Hurtbox window ends
help: Inclusive final move frame for the temporary body mask.

label: Window body mask
help: Bit mask: legs 1, torso/arms 2, head 4, extension 8. Weapons never add hurtboxes.

label: Low-crush window begins
help: During this window low strikes and ground throws miss, without changing input selection.

label: Low-crush window ends
help: Inclusive final move frame of low/ground-throw avoidance.

label: Mid/high armor duration
help: First move frames protected by hit-limited armor. Lows and throws beat it.

label: Armor hits
help: Hits absorbed within the armor window; damage and hitstop still apply.

label: Grab sequence duration
help: Ticks from capture to the single finishing hit. Target is held until the finish.

label: Finisher artwork pose
help: Optional second pose during the grab or active timeline; 0 uses the initial pose.

label: Finisher pose frame
help: Active frame or grab-sequence tick at which the finisher drawing appears.
